description: This file defines a band-limited sawtooth oscillator class for MIDI synthesis, specifically implementing a DPW (Damped Polynomial Wave) method to reduce aliasing at high frequencies.

classes.name: SawOscillatorDPW
classes.description: A sawtooth oscillator with band-limiting for high-frequency aliasing reduction, extending the SawOscillator base class.

methods.name: setFrequency
methods.description: Sets the oscillator's frequency and calculates a frequency-dependent scaler to shape the waveform accordingly.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the next sample of the oscillator output, applying a DPW technique to minimize aliasing.
